notes: Prevents rapid remote presses from starting overlapping catalog, series, update, or playback work.
Serializes VLC and Media3 fallbacks and gives the current native decoder time to shut down before the next attempt.
Scales the entire UI and all text, dialogs, menus, controls, focus targets, and grids for phones, tablets, 720p TV, 1080p TV, and 4K TV.
Uses cancellable network requests and ignores canceled or stale catalog results to reduce memory pressure on older Fire TV boxes.
